sections.title: 1. Master Fee Structure — Kredit Venture (Jads Services Pvt Ltd)
sections.summary: Mandatory fee schedule applied across all vehicle loan origination files.
items: Processing Fees: 1.25% + GST for Cars & CVs; 1.50% + GST for Tractor Loans.
Documentation Charges: ₹ 1,000 for loans up to ₹ 5 Lakhs; ₹ 2,000 for loans above ₹ 5 Lakhs.
Stamp Duty: 0.60% of Loan Account amount.
GST: Applicable at prevailing statutory rate (18%) on all service and processing fees.
